text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":20,"unit":"minutes","kind":"count","span":"20 minutes for"},{"id":"q2","value":40,"unit":"%","kind":"count","span":"40% longer"},{"id":"q3","value":5,"unit":"minutes","kind":"count","span":"5 minutes less"}],"plan":[{"op":"div","args":["q2"],"out":"s1","note":"convert 40% to a fraction by dividing by 100"},{"op":"mul","args":["s1","q1"],"out":"s2","note":"extra minutes = 40% of the initial 20-minute heating time"},{"op":"add","args":["q1","s2"],"out":"s3","note":"time to heat to 400 degrees = initial 20 minutes plus the 40% extra"},{"op":"sub","args":["s3","q3"],"out":"s4","note":"cooking time = warm-up time minus 5 minutes"},{"op":"add","args":["s3","s4"],"out":"s5","note":"total time = time to warm the oil plus time to cook"}],"target":{"kind":"count","scope":"total time from starting the oil to having cooked chicken"},"dismissed":[{"value":300,"reason":"target temperature description, not needed for the elapsed-time calculation"},{"value":400,"reason":"target temperature description, not needed for the elapsed-time calculation"}]}
